findings.claim: The public GET /groups/:name/members endpoint now defaults to limit=50 for every group, but the public route and template have no pagination controls, so members after the 50th cannot be reached.

verifier.reason: GroupsController#members in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26 defaults to limit=50 and offset=0 for every group, and Discourse.Group#findMembers in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:10-30 requests a single page with those defaults. The public route (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6:8-12) only calls model.findMembers() once and its template (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:1-22) has no pagination or load-more controls, so members past the 50th cannot be reached.

findings.claim: In the group member row itemView, {{#unless automatic}} resolves against the member (Discourse.User) rather than the group, so `automatic` is undefined and the remove link is shown for automatic groups.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:21, the keyword form {{each member in members itemView="group-member"}} sets options.hash.keyword = "member" (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:8404-8412), which causes collectionHelper (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:7997-7998) to bind the itemView's _context to _parentView.context (AdminGroupController, an Em.ObjectController proxying the Discourse.Group) while putting the Discourse.User in _keywords.member (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:8222-8224). Therefore {{#unless automatic}} in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 resolves automatic against the group controller, not the member.

findings.claim: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' controller spec sends xhr :put to remove_member, but the route is DELETE; it passes only because controller specs skip routing.

verifier.reason: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:114-117, the 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' spec calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` on line 115, whereas config/routes.rb:49 routes `DELETE members` to `groups#remove_member` (and line 50 maps `PUT members` to `groups#add_members`). Because Rails controller specs dispatch directly to the named controller action without enforcing the HTTP verb against the router, the test passes despite using `:put` instead of `:delete`.

findings.claim: The limit and offset params on the members endpoint are not validated or clamped: negative values reach SQL and cause errors, and limit has no upper cap.

verifier.reason: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26, `GroupsController#members` converts `params[:limit]` and `params[:offset]` directly with `.to_i` and passes them unvalidated to `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` on PostgreSQL, so negative values raise SQL errors and `limit` has no upper bound.

findings.claim: The usernames input is not cleared after an add operation.

verifier.reason: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:61-65, the addMembers action calls this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames")) without clearing usernames (even leaving a '// TODO: should clear the input' comment at line 62). Neither Discourse.Group#addMembers (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:51-59) nor the bound user-selector in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:28-29 clears the input after the add operation.
